question: Il mese prossimo ___ in Spagna. (Next month I will go to Spain)

question: Penso che lui ___ ragione. (I think he is right)

question: Spero che tu ___ bene. (I hope you are well)

question: Sebbene ___ stanco, ha continuato. (Although he was tired, he kept going)

question: Se avessi più tempo, ___ di più. (If I had more time, I'd read more)

question: Se fossi in te, ___ quel lavoro. (If I were you, I'd accept that job)

question: Se avessi saputo, ___ venuto. (If I had known, I would have come)
explanation: Past unreal conditions use the pluperfect subjunctive + past conditional. Literally: “If I-had known, I-would-be come”.

question: Mentre ___, ha squillato il telefono. (While I was cooking, the phone rang)
explanation: The imperfect gives the background action; the passato prossimo is the interruption. Literally: “While I-was-cooking, has rung the phone”.

question: Quando sono arrivato, il film era già ___. (When I arrived, the film had already started)

question: ___ aiutarmi, per favore? (Could you help me, please?)

question: Vorrei che tu ___ con me. (I'd like you to come with me)

question: Hai visto Maria? ___ ho vista ieri. (Have you seen Maria? I saw her yesterday)

question: Ho comprato dei fiori e ___ ho regalati ad Anna. (I bought some flowers and I gave them to Anna)

question: Dai il libro a Luca? Sì, ___ do il libro. (Do you give Luca the book? Yes, I give him the book)
explanation: 'Gli' is the indirect object pronoun 'to him'. Literally: “Give-you the book to Luca? Yes, to-him I-give the book”.

question: Non ___ preoccupare! (Don't worry! (informal))

question: Penso ___ andare al mare. (I'm thinking of going to the sea)

question: Ho voglia ___ un gelato. (I feel like having an ice cream)

question: Il libro ___ scritto da un autore famoso. (The book was written by a famous author)

question: Questa casa ___ costruita nel 1950. (This house was built in 1950)
explanation: The participle agrees with the feminine subject: stata, costruita. Literally: “This house is been built in-the 1950”.
phrase: Questa casa è stata costruita nel 1950.

question: È importante che tutti ___ le regole. (It's important that everyone follows the rules)
explanation: After impersonal expressions like 'è importante che', use the subjunctive. Literally: “It-is important that all respect the rules”.
phrase: È importante che tutti rispettino le regole.

question: Bisogna che tu ___ subito. (You need to leave right away)
